name: returns empty, singleton, and two-node lists unchanged
test:
assert odd_even_list(None) is None
one = ListNode(9)
assert odd_even_list(one) is one and one.next is None
first = ListNode(1)
second = ListNode(2)
first.next = second
assert odd_even_list(first) is first
assert first.next is second and second.next is None

name: relinks repeated-valued nodes by original position and identity
input: five nodes whose values cannot identify their original positions

name: preserves both groups order without leaving a cycle on an even-length list
test:
nodes = [ListNode(value) for value in [8, 6, 4, 2, 0, -2]]
for left, right in zip(nodes, nodes[1:]):
    left.next = right
head = odd_even_list(nodes[0])
seen = []
current = head
for _ in range(len(nodes)):
    assert current is not None
    seen.append(current)
    current = current.next
assert current is None
assert [id(node) for node in seen] == [id(nodes[index]) for index in [0, 2, 4, 1, 3, 5]]
